My First Thought Is That He Has Been Waiting. But the Image Reveals Something More. Every Cell of This Being Is Humming With Vigilant Focus. He Is _Listening_ From Head to Toe. For a Moment, I Hear What He Hears. The Magnificent Storm Bellows Violently From All Sides. My Perspective Returns to the Face. (It Is Hard to Describe the Intensity of What Comes Next.) I Watch Both of His Eyes Snap Wide Open. Light Explodes From Each Socket in Blinding White Beams, Focused Confidently Toward the Storm. A Mouth Forms and Dramatically Opens, Generating a Broad Beam of Light Which Pours Out of the Mouth (In the Shape of a Cone) Toward the Storm. As Debris From the Storm Passes Into the Light, It Immediately _Disappears_.
